The broader verification debt remains tracked independently in live_shadow, fault_restart, isolated_performance, release_publication, clean_cutover, and paper_fixture_proof. Keep Java as default and specify owner relation/lease, authenticated identity negotiation, watermark continuity, owner-scoped atomic operations, and end-to-end isolation tests before enabling any gate.
